title: The Magic of Compound Growth | Slow English Reading & Listening Practice #Shorts

subtitles.en: Many people believe you need a large income to build lasting wealth, but time is often your greatest asset.
subtitles.zh: 許多人認為需要高收入才能建立持久的財富，但時間往往是您最大的資產。

subtitles.en: Compound growth happens when your money starts earning money on its own.
subtitles.zh: 複利成長發生在您的錢開始自行賺錢的時候。

subtitles.en: Every small profit gets reinvested, slowly building momentum like a rolling snowball.
subtitles.zh: 每一筆小額利潤都會被再投資，像滾雪球一樣緩慢累積動能。

subtitles.en: Starting early makes a massive difference, even with modest monthly contributions.
subtitles.zh: 即使每月貢獻不多，提早開始也會產生巨大的影響。

subtitles.en: Consistency matters far more than timing the financial markets.
subtitles.zh: 持續性遠比掌握金融市場的時機更重要。

subtitles.en: Patient investors understand that small daily steps create long-term financial security.
subtitles.zh: 有耐心的投資者明白，每天的小步驟能創造長期的財務安全。
